Attention.name: MHA / GQA
Attention.summary: Dense attention over a per-head KV cache, with query heads sharing KV heads under GQA.

Attention.name: MLA
Attention.summary: Multi-head latent attention: every head reads one compressed KV latent per token.

Attention.name: DSA
Attention.summary: Sparse MLA: an indexer scores the cache and each query attends only to its top-k tokens.

Attention.name: Compressed sparse MLA
Attention.summary: Sparse MLA over a compressed KV cache: every few tokens are pooled into one key, and each query attends to a sliding window of recent tokens plus compressed keys.

Attention.name: Gated DeltaNet
Attention.summary: Linear attention: a gated delta-rule state stands in for the KV cache.

MoE.name: Expert compute
MoE.summary: The routed experts' matrix multiplies and the activation between them, as fused MoE calls or grouped GEMMs.

MoE.name: Routing and combine
MoE.summary: Choose each token's experts, group tokens by expert for the GEMMs, and sum the expert outputs back into one row per token.

Normalization.name: RMSNorm
Normalization.summary: Root-mean-square normalization of hidden rows, alone or fused with a residual add, a gate or a second input.

Normalization.name: Hyper-connections
Normalization.summary: mHC: each token keeps several residual streams, mixed before and after every block; these calls fuse the mixing with RMSNorm.

kernels.title: All-reduce
kernels.summary: Sum one buffer across the GPUs of a tensor-parallel group.

kernels.title: All-reduce, FlashInfer kernels
kernels.summary: Sum a [num_tokens, hidden_dim] tensor across the GPUs of a tensor-parallel group with FlashInfer's all-reduce.

kernels.title: All-reduce + residual add + RMSNorm
kernels.summary: Sum a tensor across GPUs, add the residual and RMS-normalize the result in a fused call.

kernels.title: Batched GEMM
kernels.summary: Multiply one activation and weight matrix pair per attention head (MLA) or per head group (grouped output projection).

kernels.title: BF16 fused MoE
kernels.summary: Route tokens through BF16 experts and combine their gated MLP outputs.

kernels.title: Clamped SwiGLU
kernels.summary: Clamp the gate and up projections, then multiply SiLU of the gate by the up projection.

kernels.title: Compressed sparse MLA decode
kernels.summary: Attend from each decode query to sliding-window and optional compressed keys.

kernels.title: Compressed sparse MLA prefill
kernels.summary: Attend from prefill queries to sliding-window and optional compressed keys.

kernels.title: Compressed sparse MLA with fused RoPE and FP8 cast
kernels.summary: Rotate the queries, attend to sliding-window and selected compressed keys, then un-rotate the output and cast it to FP8, in one attention segment.

kernels.title: Compressed prefill indexer logits
kernels.summary: Score prefill queries against compressed keys for sparse token selection.

kernels.title: Compressed prefill indexer top-k
kernels.summary: Select compressed cache positions from indexer logits for each prefill query.

kernels.title: Indexer key cache append
kernels.summary: Quantize new DSA index keys and write them into a paged FP8 cache.

kernels.title: Indexer query RoPE and FP8 quantization
kernels.summary: Rotate indexer queries and quantize them to FP8 while producing per-head weights.

kernels.title: Indexer query RoPE and FP8 quantization, scales in weights
kernels.summary: Rotate and quantize indexer queries while folding their FP8 scales into head weights.

kernels.title: Prefill indexer logits
kernels.summary: Score each prefill query against causal index keys and reduce across indexer heads.

kernels.title: Decode indexer logits
kernels.summary: Score decode queries against paged index keys and reduce across indexer heads.

kernels.title: Decode indexer top-k
kernels.summary: Select request-local token positions from indexer logits for each DSA decode query.

kernels.title: Sparse index remap
kernels.summary: Map DSA-selected request-local token indices to cache or prefill-workspace positions.

kernels.title: Sparse MLA attention
kernels.summary: Attend to the DSA-selected cache tokens for each query head.

kernels.title: Sparse MLA prefill
kernels.summary: Attend to selected compressed KV tokens for a batch of prefill queries.

kernels.title: Prefill indexer top-k
kernels.summary: Choose the highest-scoring index-key positions for each prefill query.

kernels.title: Elementwise byte pass
kernels.summary: Read a whole multiple of the output size, or nothing, and write the output.

kernels.title: Engram n-gram embedding lookup
kernels.summary: Gather hashed n-gram rows from a large FP8 table, dequantize them and write BF16 rows for the layers that consume them.

kernels.title: Paged decode attention
kernels.summary: One query token per request attending over its paged KV cache, for a whole decode batch.

kernels.title: Causal prefill attention
kernels.summary: Attend a block of new query tokens over its preceding context and itself.

kernels.title: Non-causal rectangular attention
kernels.summary: Attend every query token over every key and value token in one request.

kernels.title: FP8 block quantization
kernels.summary: Quantize BF16 expert inputs to FP8 E4M3 in 128-element blocks.

kernels.title: FP8 block-scale grouped GEMM
kernels.summary: Multiply routed fp8 token rows by block-scaled expert weights and write bf16 output.

kernels.title: FP8 per-token-group quantization
kernels.summary: Quantize BF16 activation rows to FP8 E4M3 with a scale per 128-element group.

kernels.title: Decode causal convolution
kernels.summary: Apply a depthwise causal convolution and SiLU to one token per request, updating the convolution state.

kernels.title: Prefill causal convolution
kernels.summary: Apply a depthwise causal convolution and SiLU to fresh sequences and save their final input samples as state.

kernels.title: Fused chunked delta rule
kernels.summary: Compute Gated DeltaNet prefill output and final recurrent states in one launch.

kernels.title: Gated DeltaNet output RMSNorm
kernels.summary: RMS-normalize each recurrent output row and multiply it by a SiLU gate.

kernels.title: Prefill post-convolution split
kernels.summary: Split the convolution output into normalized queries and keys, values, the log decay and beta.

kernels.title: Recurrent decode
kernels.summary: Update the gated delta-rule state and read one output token per request.

kernels.title: FP32-output GEMM
kernels.summary: Multiply bf16 or fp32 activations and weights while writing an fp32 result.

kernels.title: Grouped GEMM
kernels.summary: Multiply routed token batches by their respective MoE expert weights.

kernels.title: Inverse RoPE and FP8 quantization
kernels.summary: Undo RoPE on attention outputs and quantize them in groups for the output projection.

kernels.title: KDA chunked prefill
kernels.summary: Compute KDA prefill output and final recurrent states, with a decay gate per key channel, in one call.

kernels.title: KDA recurrent decode
kernels.summary: Update each request's KDA state, gated per key channel, and read one output token.

kernels.title: Paged KV cache append
kernels.summary: Write the keys and values of new tokens into their slots in a paged KV cache.

kernels.title: KV compression and store
kernels.summary: Save partial states, then compress and store keys at compression boundaries.

kernels.title: Logits top-k
kernels.summary: Select the largest top_k scores and their column indices from each score row.

kernels.title: mHC post-block, pre-block and RMSNorm
kernels.summary: Mix a block's output into the mHC residual streams, then compute the next block's mixing weights and normalized input, in one call.

kernels.title: mHC pre-block with RMSNorm
kernels.summary: From a token's parallel residual streams, compute the mHC mixing weights and the RMS-normalized input of the next block.

kernels.title: Terminal mHC head
kernels.summary: Collapse the final mHC residual channels into one hidden state and RMS-normalize it for the LM head.

kernels.title: MLA cache append
kernels.summary: Write compressed KV latents and rotary keys into paged MLA cache entries.

kernels.title: MLA RoPE and FP8 quantization
kernels.summary: Rotate MLA queries and keys, quantize them to FP8, and assemble each query.

kernels.title: MoE block alignment
kernels.summary: Group routed token IDs by expert and pad each group to a block boundary.

kernels.title: MoE all-to-all transfer
kernels.summary: Move token rows to expert GPUs or return expert outputs to their source GPUs.

kernels.title: MoE all-to-all preparation
kernels.summary: Build and exchange the row indices needed for expert-parallel dispatch.

kernels.title: MoE all-gather of hidden states and router logits
kernels.summary: Gather hidden states and router logits from every data-parallel GPU.

kernels.title: MoE output reduce-scatter
kernels.summary: Sum expert outputs across GPUs and return each GPU's token shard.

kernels.title: MoE finalization with shared output
kernels.summary: Gather and weight routed expert outputs, optionally adding the shared-expert row.

kernels.title: MoE routing finalization
kernels.summary: Unpermute, scale and sum local expert outputs into one row per original token.

kernels.title: Fused MoE top-k routing
kernels.summary: Select top-k experts from softmax router scores and renormalize their weights.

kernels.title: MoE expert sum
kernels.summary: Sum the routed expert output rows for each token.

kernels.title: Softplus-sqrt MoE routing
kernels.summary: Select experts with sqrt-softplus scores or a token hash table and produce scaled weights.

kernels.title: MXFP4 Marlin MoE GEMM
kernels.summary: Multiply routed BF16 activations by packed MXFP4 expert weights in one Marlin launch.

kernels.title: Block-scaled fused MoE
kernels.summary: Route block-quantized tokens through packed expert weights and produce their MoE outputs.

kernels.title: NVFP4 activation quantization
kernels.summary: Quantize BF16 activation rows to packed NVFP4 values and E4M3 group scales.

kernels.title: Inter-domain point-to-point transfer
kernels.summary: Modeled time for one transfer between GPUs in different NVLink domains.

kernels.title: Intra-domain point-to-point transfer
kernels.summary: Send one payload between two GPUs in the same NVLink domain.

kernels.title: Packed KV cache gather
kernels.summary: Gather and dequantize paged FP8 keys into a BF16 prefill workspace.

kernels.title: Query and KV RMSNorm
kernels.summary: RMS-normalize query-side and KV-side projections with separate weights.

kernels.title: Query padding, KV RoPE and MXFP8 window insert
kernels.summary: Copy the live query heads into a zero-padded buffer while rotating, quantizing to MXFP8 and inserting KV rows into a sliding-window cache.

kernels.title: Query norm, RoPE and KV insert
kernels.summary: Normalize and rotate queries while rotating and inserting mixed FP8/bf16 KV rows into a packed MLA cache.

kernels.title: Residual add + RMSNorm
kernels.summary: Add the residual stream, then normalize: the fused step between transformer blocks.

kernels.title: RMSNorm
kernels.summary: Normalize each token's hidden vector by its root mean square and scale it by a weight.

kernels.title: Dense GEMM
kernels.summary: One matrix multiply: an activation block of m tokens times a weight matrix.

kernels.title: vLLM fused MoE GEMM
kernels.summary: Gather selected token rows and multiply them by FP8 expert weights in one Triton launch.

kernels.title: vLLM MLA query RoPE
kernels.summary: Rotate the MLA query's positional columns and materialize the full query tensor.
